'''Planetary Operations Tactical Command''', abbreviated as '''TacComm''', was a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] military organization charged with deployments on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. During the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Second Battle of Coruscant|invasion]] of Coruscant, TacComm was responsible for deploying reaction [[Squad/Legends|squads]] across the planet.
